seo.title: BKK Airport Guide: Suvarnabhumi Terminals & Transport | Tripways
seo.subheadline: Bangkok's flagship international hub: terminals, transport, and departure advice
seo.meta_description: Complete passenger guide for Bangkok Suvarnabhumi Airport (BKK). Includes Airport Rail Link transit, Satellite Terminal SAT-1, and taxi advice.

faqs.answer: Take the Airport Rail Link (ARL) from Basement Level B. A one-way ticket to Phaya Thai station (interchange for the BTS Skytrain) costs 45 THB and takes 26 minutes.
faqs.question: How do I take the train from Suvarnabhumi Airport to central Bangkok?

faqs.answer: Yes, a free airport shuttle runs between BKK (Level 2, Gate 3) and DMK for passengers holding a valid boarding pass or ticket departing from the connecting airport within 24 hours.
faqs.question: Is there free shuttle bus transit between Suvarnabhumi (BKK) and Don Mueang (DMK)?

steps.body: Flights docking at Satellite Terminal SAT-1 connect to the Main Terminal via a 3-minute underground Automated People Mover (APM) train running every 3 minutes.
steps.title: 1. Arrival Concourse & APM Train

steps.body: Proceed to Immigration on the 2nd Floor. Foreign passport holders should follow signs to international visitor counters. Baggage carousels are located immediately behind passport control.
steps.title: 2. Passport Control & Customs

steps.body: Descend to Level 1 for official metered taxi kiosks or Level B for the Airport Rail Link train station directly into central Bangkok.
steps.title: 3. Ground Transport

arrival.summary: Arrival procedures, immigration clearance, and ground transit connections.

lounges.name: Miracle Lounge
lounges.access_summary: Priority Pass, DragonPass, and walk-in pass (~1,300 THB)
lounges.location_summary: Concourses A, C, D, F, G, and Concourse SAT-1

lounges.name: Thai Airways Royal Orchid Prestige Lounge
lounges.access_summary: Star Alliance Gold, Royal Orchid Plus, and Royal Silk Business Class

notices.body: If your gate is in Concourse SAT-1, allow at least 20 minutes from immigration to reach your departure gate via the APM train.
notices.title: SAT-1 Gate Walking Times

steps.body: All airline departures check in on Level 4. Thai Airways counters are located in Rows A–C; foreign international airlines occupy Rows D–W.
steps.title: 1. Check-in Counters (Level 4)

steps.body: Security screening is situated on the mezzanine level above check-in rows, leading directly down to immigration clearance booths.
steps.title: 2. Security Screening & Passport Control

steps.body: If your boarding gate starts with 'S' (Gates S101–S128), board the automated shuttle train on Basement 1 to reach Concourse SAT-1. Allow 15 extra minutes.
steps.title: 3. Gate Navigation & SAT-1 Transfers

departure.summary: Departure check-in, security screening, and boarding gate navigation.

transport.name: Airport Rail Link (City Line)
transport.summary: Fast and congestion-free electric train stopping at 8 stations across Bangkok before terminating at Phaya Thai.
transport.pickup_location_summary: Basement Level B, beneath the main passenger terminal

transport.name: Official Public Metered Taxi
transport.summary: Automated ticket kiosk assigns a numbered taxi bay. Regulated meter fare plus 50 THB airport surcharge and expressway tolls.

facilities.name: Tourist SIM Counters
facilities.summary: Official AIS, TrueMove H, and dtac kiosks on Level 2 (Arrivals) offering unlimited 5G data packages.

facilities.name: Luggage Storage & Delivery
facilities.summary: Bellugg and Airportels counters available on Level 2 and Level B for same-day hotel delivery.

orientation.intro: Suvarnabhumi Airport (BKK) is Bangkok's primary international airport, located 30 km east of downtown Bangkok in Samut Prakan province.
orientation.summary: Featuring one of the world's largest single-building passenger terminals and the new Satellite Terminal 1 (SAT-1), serving major long-haul and regional flag carriers.
